A fragment of a base silver finger ring dating to the second century AD. The fragment comprises a small portion of the shoulders and the integrally cast bezel. The bezel is hexagonal in plan and rectangular in section. There is an incised inscription on the bezel which reads [...] M (turned through 90 degrees) E.
